target.title: fix(telegram): preserve authored file-reference links
target.body: Closes #105679 ## What Problem This Solves Telegram's formatter treated any link whose visible label looked like its file-like hostname as an automatically linkified file reference. That made an authored link such as `[main.ts](https://main.ts)` indistinguishable from MarkdownIt's automatic `README.md` link and silently replaced the authored anchor with `main.ts`. ## Why This Change Was Made Preserve MarkdownIt's link origin in the shared Markdown IR. Links produced by the `linkify` rule receive an optional `autoLinked` fact, while explicit Markdown links and angle-bracket autolinks remain authored links. The fact is retained through table rendering, trimming, clamping, and slicing. Telegram now suppresses file-like links only when the IR confirms they were automatically linkified. Raw HTML anchors are preserved because their origin cannot be established safely after parsing. This fixes both the primary Markdown IR renderer and chunk/table transformations instead of applying a regex-only workaround at the final HTML layer. ## User Impact Intentional Telegram links whose labels resemble file names keep their destinations, while plain file references such as `README.md` continue to render as code and avoid unwanted registrar previews. ## Evidence - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/markdown-core/src/ir.blockquote-spacing.test.ts packages/markdown-core/src/ir.chunking.test.ts packages/markdown-core/src/ir.emphasis-cjk.test.ts packages/markdown-core/src/ir.hr-spacing.test.ts packages/markdown-core/src/ir.links.test.ts packages/markdown-core/src/ir.nested-lists.test.ts packages/markdown-core/src/ir.raw-html.test.ts packages/markdown-core/src/ir.table-block.test.ts packages/markdown-core/src/ir.table-bullets.test.ts packages/markdown-core/src/ir.table-code.test.ts` — 87 tests passed. - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/markdown-core/src/ir.links.test.ts packages/markdown-core/src/ir.table-bullets.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/format.wrap-md.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/format.test.ts` — 122 tests passed across the focused Markdown and Telegram shards. - `OPENCLAW_CHECK_CHANGED_REMOTE_CHILD=1 OPENCLAW_CHANGED_LANES_RAW_SYNC=1 CI=1 PNPM_CONFIG_VERIFY_DEPS_BEFORE_RUN=false node scripts/check-changed.mjs -- packages/markdown-core/src/ir.ts packages/markdown-core/src/ir.links.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/format.ts extensions/telegram/src/format.wrap-md.test.ts` — passed, including core/extension typecheck and lint. - `git diff --check` — passed. `node --max-old-space-size=8192 scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.mjs --check` reports the same pre-existing deprecated-export budget failures on an untouched current `main` checkout (`conversation-runtime` and `channel-pairing`); this PR does not alter those entrypoints or the generated Plugin SDK baseline. No live Telegram Bot API send was performed locally; the PR has source-level and focused renderer proof, with CI and channel validation remaining the external verification lanes.
